## Change

Describe the behavior change and link any related issue.

## Verification

List exact commands and results. State explicitly which checks were not run.
Distinguish Linux tests, native macOS builds/packaging, and interactive Mac tests.
Do not paste raw logs or local environment dumps.

## Review Checklist

- [ ] Tests or documentation cover the change, or an explanation is provided.
- [ ] Examples and fixtures are synthetic, with no session data, credentials, personal paths, or identifying screenshots.
- [ ] Runtime remains local-only, without networking, telemetry, or credential access.
- [ ] Estimates are not presented as bills, verified balances, complete coverage, or enforced spending caps.
- [ ] Unknown prices, partial imports, and source-format limitations remain explicit where relevant.
- [ ] Any workflow action updates use verified full commit SHAs and least privilege.
